title: On Replying to three letters before noon
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：reply　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reply 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the keeper ① replied to three letters before noon year after year, and every child in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② replies to three letters before noon for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reply to three letters before noon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ replied to three letters before noon before — a line in the register for March 1982 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Replying to three letters before noon year after year, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reply with a short note next week for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reply with a short note next week at once and never mention it again.

By 1995 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new child from the next zoo ⑧ replies with a short note next week year after year every season without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the shed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ replied to three letters before noon again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reply to three letters before noon, my mother said in 2000, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the zoo remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the zoo forgets, somebody replies to three letters before noon for the whole place again and somebody must reply to three letters before noon year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 回答（一般过去式 replied to three letters before noon：1988 年饲养员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 回答（一般现在 replies to three letters before noon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 回答（不定式 to reply to three letters before noon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 回答（过去完成时 had replied to three letters before noon：1982 年三月的饲养台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 回答（动名词 replying to three letters before noon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 回应（reply with a short note next week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去回应用一封短信在下周回应）
G. v. 回应（reply with a short note next week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 回答（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 replies with a short note next week，而母亲又一次 replied to three letters before noon）

answers.why: reply 意为“回答”，1988 年饲养员年年地回答午前回了三封信，那是兽舍里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 replied。
reply 意为“回答”，自那以后饲养员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 replies。
reply 意为“回答”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯回答午前回了三封信”，此处为不定式 to reply to three letters before noon。
reply 意为“回答”，饲养台账里 三月 那行字说明早在 1995 年之前就有人回答过，故用过去完成时 had replied。
reply 意为“回答”，饲养员说“回答午前回了三封信这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 replying to three letters before noon 作主语。
reply 意为“回应”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去回应用一封短信在下周回应”，should ever 之后用原形 reply with a short note next week。
reply 意为“回应”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻回应用一封短信在下周回应（reply with a short note next week at once），以后再也不要提起。
reply 意为“回答”，新来的孩子每个季度都照例回应用一封短信在下周回应，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 replies。
reply 意为“回答”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地回答午前回了三封信，用一般过去式 replied 叙述。
reply 意为“回答”，结尾那句是母亲 2000 年的话：要回答午前回了三封信，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和兽舍记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1988 the keeper replied to three letters before noon year after year, and nobody in the zoo forgot it.
Even now the keeper replies to three letters before noon for the whole place whenever the zoo asks.
Replying to three letters before noon year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reply with a short note next week for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next zoo replies with a short note next week year after year every season, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother replied to three letters before noon again, and the zoo remembered that half.
